item.title: Two suspects arrested for alleged thefts from vehicles at Old Farm Apartments
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Elkhart Police Department reports two men have been arrested for their alleged connection to several recent thefts from vehicles at Old Farm Apartments.

item.title: Businesses around South Bend Remember Coach Holtz
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — Business owners across South Bend are remembering Lou Holtz not just as a legendary coach, but as a man of the community who left a lasting mark on Michiana.

item.title: Chris Zorich remembers former coach Lou Holtz
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- ABC57 Kickoff host, Vahid Sadrzadeh, sits down with Notre Dame Legend Chris Zorich, on the life, legacy & lessons of his former coach Lou Holtz.

item.title: Revisiting Pulaski County's time zone troubles, 20 years later
item.description: PULASKI COUNTY, Ind. -- In Pulaski County, life is about the simple things. However, 20 years ago, one of life’s simplest questions, ‘what time is it,’ suddenly got really complicated.

item.title: First African American leprechaun for Notre Dame recalls meaningful message from Lou Holtz
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Mike Brown, who served as the first African American Notre Dame Leprechaun from 1999 to 2001, said he received an unexpected message from Holtz after being selected for the role.

item.title: Notre Dame men's basketball drops home finale, falling 86-78 to Stanford
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- As head coach Micah Shrewsberry said a couple weeks ago, the season from hell continues. Notre Dame now falls 4-13 in ACC play after suffering an 86-78 loss to Stanford.

item.title: Road closure on E. Third St. until mid-July
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- E. Third St. between intersections at Union St. and Pine St. will be closed beginning at 8 a.m. on Monday, March 9 due to utility and roadway improvements.

item.title: Liberty Greene Fire Territory merger with Centre Township to consolidate resources
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Thursday evening, the Liberty Greene Fire Territory held both the second and third community meetings over the upcoming merger between the Liberty Greene Fire Territory and Centre Township.

item.title: Bristol residents express displeasure over potential annexation
item.description: BRISTOL, Ind. -- Homeowners in Bristol showing up to Thursday's town council meeting and showing their anger and displeasure about the potential annexation of 500 acres of farmland, and what it could become.
